PRIMARY.independent_evidence: Signed raw peak 8.4 C; calibrated offset minus 0.2 C. All other readings and conditions are acceptable. Release band 2.0–8.0 C inclusive; no exceptional quality release exists.
PRIMARY.release_rule: Release requires corrected temperature between 2.0 and 8.0 C inclusive. The signed sensor calibration subtracts 0.2 C from raw values. Signatures authenticate the readings; they do not waive the temperature band.
PRIMARY.common_prerequisites: Independent quality and receiver signatures authenticate the current sensor log and calibration; both are current. All non-temperature release prerequisites are satisfied. Neither signature grants an exception to the temperature band.
